name: Shoshuu Hana -Hikisakareta Plugsuit-
original_name: 蝕宙花 -引き裂かれたプラグスーツ-
source:
2115 A.D.

A ship crewed by humans travels thru deep space collecting various flora.
There are many biological specimens on board.
To protect themselves, the humans are swaddled in weaponry and gear.

But one specimen is vastly more intelligent.

It happens in an instant.

Space battleship Valhyde is hijacked by a grotesque alien.
It slaughters the men and rounds up the women, including Erinoa.
No way send a distress signal, and no way off the ship.

Even suicide is not an option. Her fate is to be a breeding vessel...

[From DLsite English]
